cards.label: Product proof first
cards.summary: An austere enterprise-product route led by actual VULCA screens, semantic layers, masks, version records, and adoption states, with almost no campaign spectacle.

visual_ops.composition: large evidence panels in a strict left-to-right sequence, with one real screenshot or artifact per state
visual_ops.color: warm white and ink black with VULCA cobalt as the sole accent
visual_ops.texture: flat UI surfaces, crisp masks, and minimal material photography
visual_ops.camera: orthographic product and interface views with no dramatic crop
visual_ops.typography: large Chinese labels and very limited technical metadata
visual_ops.symbol_strategy: version state, protected region, selected layer, and adopted output are the only symbols
avoid: mock UI presented as live product

evaluation_focus.L1: the workflow reads instantly at presentation distance
evaluation_focus.L2: screens and masks are genuine, sharp, and internally consistent
evaluation_focus.L3: localization decisions are grounded rather than decorative
evaluation_focus.L4: the visual proves a real enterprise control task
evaluation_focus.L5: the work communicates persistent enterprise capability above replaceable models

cards.risk: High credibility but insufficient first-glance desire; the company may look like an internal workflow or governance tool.

cards.label: Campaign spectacle first
cards.summary: A high-fashion editorial beauty route dominated by a cinematic lipstick hero and cross-channel campaign derivatives generated with GPT Image 2.

visual_ops.composition: one dramatic lipstick or product-and-hand hero with generous copy space and secondary channel crops
visual_ops.color: warm ivory, deep black, rich carmine, and subtle metallic highlights
visual_ops.texture: matte lacquer, satin paper, cosmetic pigment, and clean studio reflections
visual_ops.lighting: directional luxury studio lighting with soft falloff
visual_ops.camera: premium macro product photography with one stable hero angle
visual_ops.typography: no generated text; all deck text is overlaid later
visual_ops.symbol_strategy: material, color, and composition carry the brand story; no explicit workflow symbols

evaluation_focus.L1: the hero is immediately legible and commercially polished
evaluation_focus.L2: materials, reflections, and product geometry are believable
evaluation_focus.L3: the campaign avoids tokenized cultural symbolism
evaluation_focus.L4: the image supports a credible cross-market launch story
evaluation_focus.L5: the campaign has a distinct visual thesis beyond luxury styling

cards.risk: Maximum visual appeal but weak product differentiation; viewers may conclude that VULCA is simply another image generator.

cards.label: Dual evidence system
cards.summary: One premium, brand-neutral beauty campaign world supplies the emotional hook, while actual VULCA artifacts from the same task prove semantic control, constrained revision, review, provenance, and adoption continuity across model changes.

visual_ops.composition: a dominant campaign hero for attraction, followed by large before-layer-target-after evidence states derived from the same source visual
visual_ops.color: warm ivory and ink black foundation, VULCA cobalt for control evidence, one lipstick-carmine accent for the campaign
visual_ops.texture: premium matte cosmetic materials and soft studio light in the hero; crisp masks, layer boundaries, and version states in evidence views
visual_ops.lighting: editorial studio lighting for campaign pixels and neutral inspection lighting for evidence artifacts
visual_ops.camera: one stable product angle maintained across versions so non-target preservation is visible
visual_ops.typography: no generated campaign copy; deck-level Chinese headlines and short evidence labels are added after generation
visual_ops.symbol_strategy: the same product identity persisting through model-rendered variants is the central symbol; masks and adopted-state markers make the control layer visible
avoid: real brand logos or implied customer endorsement
mock VULCA screens presented as actual runs
AI robots and neon technology clichés

evaluation_focus.L1: campaign and proof layers remain readable at normal presentation distance
evaluation_focus.L2: product geometry, material fidelity, masks, and non-target preservation are technically credible
evaluation_focus.L3: China-to-UK localization is specific and respectful without national-symbol shorthand
evaluation_focus.L4: the viewer understands the enterprise job, VULCA's role, and the replaceable rendering-model boundary
evaluation_focus.L5: the visual system expresses enterprise memory and control as the durable value, not image novelty

cards.risk: If the actual VULCA run is weak or visually too small, the concept hero will overpower the proof and recreate the image-generator interpretation.
